summary: Validated VERO coach-comment + profile timezone endpoints in Weight & Metabolism. 9/9 backend tests passed (8.71s). Tone classifier (positive/suggestive/caution/neutral), cache behavior (2nd call cached + faster + identical text), German/<=180/no-emoji/no-markdown comment constraints, timezone PUT/GET (incl. empty + whitespace -> 400, upsert overwrite), and no _id leak — all verified with real gpt-4o-mini (3 LLM calls total).
critical_code_review_comments: coach-comment endpoint correctly skips LLM for tiny-snack (cal<150 + neutral tone) — saves tokens, verified <3s round-trip.
Cache key is {name|cal|round(protein)} truncated to 160 chars — adequate but case is lower()'d only for name; numeric rounding means protein 20.0 vs 20.4 collide (acceptable trade-off).

Cache layer has no TTL/index — meal_coach_cache will grow unbounded over time. Consider a TTL index on created_at (e.g. 90 days) or a unique index on `key` to make insert idempotent (currently insert_one inside try/except for races — works but noisy).

Comment is post-processed only via .strip().strip('"').strip("'")[:180]; LLM could still return markdown headers/bullets. In all 3 sampled outputs none did, but consider an explicit markdown-strip (re.sub for **,*,`,#,>,-) for safety.
ProfileTimezoneRequest doesn't validate offset_minutes range (could accept absurd values like 99999). Low priority.
Timezone string is whitelisted only by length (<=64) — any non-IANA string is accepted (e.g. 'Foo/Bar' returns 200). Consider zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz) validation for robustness.
weight_metabolism.py is now 968 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting (coach-comment + timezone could go to a sub-router).
test_credentials: n/a — endpoints are unauthenticated; profile_id strings prefixed TEST_
seed_data_creation: Created cache rows under meal_coach_cache for hashes derived from TEST_huettenkaese_*, TEST_pommes_*, TEST_doener_* (each unique per run via uuid suffix, so no collisions). Timezone docs created under TEST_tz_* profiles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_weight_metabolism_coach_timezone.py — uses uuid-suffixed meal names so cache reuse from prior runs is avoided. Endpoint paths confirmed: POST /api/weight-metabolism/{pid}/coach-comment, PUT/GET /api/weight-metabolism/{pid}/timezone. Tone thresholds verified: positive(cal>=150 & ratio>=6), suggestive(cal>=300 & ratio<2), caution(cal>=600), else neutral with comment=null when cal<150. Cache stored in meal_coach_cache with key=lower(name)|cal|round(protein) truncated to 160 chars.
